scope: focused before/after proof of the stock Web pin plus the proof-only community augmentation profile

artifact_only_boot.fact: The DSH profile sets autoInstallPeers=false. Installing only the two candidate artifacts left Spotlight's declared cordis and schemastery peers absent, and boot stopped with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for schemastery.

composed_boot.fact: Adding the exact peer versions from Spotlight's own source lock produced a clean peer check and booted both candidate bundle rows. This peer step is an integration requirement, not an active-profile change.

before.source: T-63.9 stock run recorded by commit 67cb86b

keyboard.fact: Stock Tab, Enter, Shift+Enter, and Escape worked, but no efficient global binding reached New Session, recent sessions, Search, Settings, or sidebar navigation.

phone_390x844.fact: Stock Settings retained a clipped narrow content column in a fixed two-column dialog, and the open 280px sidebar squeezed the live conversation into the remaining width.

multiple_clients.fact: A second independent browser origin reached stock Web through an actual loopback SSH local forward and loaded the first client's persisted prompt; no physical phone was exercised.

safe_remote_access.fact: Stock Web stayed on 127.0.0.1, authenticated SSH supplied per-device transport, and 0.0.0.0 was refused.

keyboard.fact: Ctrl+K opened Spotlight; keyboard-only filtering plus Enter created a new conversation, opened the persisted recent session, expanded native Search with focus in its textbox, opened Settings directly on Plugins, and collapsed or reopened the sidebar. Escape closed the palette.
limitations: There is no direct General-settings result; the built-in Open installed plugin settings action opens Settings on Plugins and native Settings navigation remains necessary from there.
Spotlight discovers some visible controls through the current DOM, so selector drift can silently reduce the action catalog after host UI changes.
The shortcut and its preference are browser-origin-local and do not change DSH session semantics.

phone_390x844.fact: The exact T-63.9 failures closed at 390x844: Settings measured 390x844 with flex-direction column, a 390px content region with no horizontal overflow, and a vertically scrollable 704/754px General body; the open sidebar floated as a 280px overlay while the frame remained 56px + 334px + 0, so the conversation retained 334px instead of being squeezed beside 280px.
limitations: The four Settings tabs occupy one horizontal row but require horizontal scrolling to reveal the final tab at this width.
The sidebar is a 280px overlay rather than the package README's literal full-screen description.
This CSS layout proof does not prove touch targets, soft-keyboard behavior, IME, approvals, questions, long transcripts, or physical-phone deployment.

session_semantics.fact: The stock Web host created and durably stored the multiline user turn, rendered the expected local MISSING_CREDENTIAL result, and exposed the same session to both clients. Neither candidate adds a session protocol or server data channel.

multiple_clients.fact: A second clean browser origin at 127.0.0.1:13081 traversed an actual ssh -L 127.0.0.1:13081:127.0.0.1:3081 process, listed the first client's workspace and session, and loaded the persisted two-line prompt and MISSING_CREDENTIAL result. No physical phone was exercised.

safe_remote_access.fact: The candidate server and SSH forward both listened only on 127.0.0.1. The candidate-composed 0.0.0.0 launch exited 1 before creating a listener with the stock remote-code-execution warning. The plugins added no authentication and justified no weaker topology.

browser_diagnostics.fact: No console messages, uncaught page errors, or captured failed network requests were observed during the focused run.

reasons: Spotlight supplied keyboard-only routes for every T-63.9 global-navigation category exercised by this proof
the reversible mobile CSS closed the measured Settings-column and sidebar-squeeze failures at exactly 390x844
stock session persistence, two-client continuity, the loopback listener, and the authenticated SSH-forward topology remained unchanged
remaining_risks: the exact Spotlight artifact requires explicit peer installation in DSH's autoInstallPeers=false profile
both projects are days old and Spotlight's DOM-discovered actions can drift
the CSS overlay proves only the focused layout cases, not touch, IME, approvals, questions, long transcripts, or a physical phone
no model-backed qq/pi2dsh cutover blockers were retested or removed
